summary: Build practical emergency supply, inventory, transport, and reporting skills. Explore the five-day course outline and plan your training.
lede: Emergency logistics is the planning and coordination of supplies, transport, storage, and resources for crisis response. For humanitarian logistics officers, emergency coordinators, and supply officers, this training covers prioritizing needs and identifying stock gaps, planning sourcing and feasible routes, and tracking inventory and reporting resource status through practical exercises.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate emergency supplies, field movement, storage, and resource decisions across response operations.
modules: Emergency Logistics Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to logistics, supply operations, humanitarian response, or emergency coordination is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to complete the digital tracking exercises; QGIS familiarity is not required because map interpretation and basic workflow use are taught at an operational level.
